name: Kiran Krishnakumar Subhashini
description: Kiran Krishnakumar Subhashini (Kiran K S) is a founder and software engineer in Kozhikode, Kerala, India. He is founder, CEO and managing director of Txtudio Coretech Private Limited and CEO of Lofritex IT Solutions LLP, and studied at College of Engineering Vadakara.

experience.summary: I co-founded Txtudio with Arun Rajanikanth (Director) and Devang C V (COO) and lead it from Kozhikode as CEO and managing director. We build software for the work that can't go wrong.
highlights: Four products: Workeron Suite, Snaptiqz, DoYourDesign and Audit Management Solution
Recognised by Kerala Startup Mission and Startup India (DPIIT)
Company-reported: 500+ events and 25,000+ tickets on Snaptiqz, 10+ companies on Workeron
Snaptiqz is listed as a partner of Kerala Police HAC'KP 2026

experience.summary: I co-founded Lofritex with Shibin Rasheed and Nandu Krishna T (CTO) and lead it as CEO. We build custom software, ERP, payroll and inventory systems, and web and mobile apps for clients in India, Saudi Arabia, Sweden and Dubai.
highlights: Our product, Manage Matey ERP, grew out of a contractor ERP built for a client in Saudi Arabia
Client work includes the Mitee Interiors website, built in Astro, and a web page for Gear Monkey
Company-reported: 50+ projects, 10+ team members and clients in 4+ countries

experience.role: Associate Software Engineer, then Lead Engineer
experience.summary: I joined Acodez as an associate software engineer and grew into the lead engineer role, leading a software development team and managing infrastructure.

experience.org: CEV Innovation and Entrepreneurship Development Cell
experience.summary: I am a mentor in the Innovation and Entrepreneurship Development Cell (IEDC) at College of Engineering Vadakara, where I studied.
highlights: Listed in the IEDC team as Founder, Lofritex and Txtudio
Lofritex and Txtudio both appear among the cell's entrepreneurship initiatives

leadership.org: IEEE Computer Society Student Branch Chapter, College of Engineering Vadakara
leadership.summary: I founded the chapter and chaired it for over two years. In 2021 I ran a Git, HTML, CSS and JavaScript task series for students, published as seven repositories on the chapter's GitHub organisation.

knowsAbout: Business suite software (HR, CRM, project management)

resume.summary: I am a founder and engineer in Kozhikode, Kerala, running two software companies with my co-founders: Txtudio Coretech (since 2025) and Lofritex IT Solutions (since 2024). I work plan-first, direct AI coding agents and ask for file-and-line evidence in security reviews. I hold a B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering from College of Engineering Vadakara, where I founded the IEEE Computer Society chapter.

projects.name: Blockchain-as-a-Service
projects.line: Final-year project: a SolidStart and TypeScript frontend for writing, compiling and deploying Solidity contracts, with interaction UIs generated from the ABI and scoped API keys.

projects.name: IoT fingerprint attendance
projects.line: ESP8266 firmware with a fingerprint sensor, reporting to an Express admin app on Firebase; deleting a student also removes their fingerprint from the device.

projects.name: Travelian
projects.line: Travel review platform built on the well-known YelpCamp course architecture, then extended with an admin dashboard, rating model, profile page and admin CLI.

projects.name: iNSiGHT
projects.line: Civic-transparency dApp built in about eight hours with SolidStart, web3.js and MetaMask; won a hackathon at CAPE Fest.

projects.name: Rust Sass watcher
projects.line: A small Rust binary that watches a folder and compiles SCSS to compressed CSS with grass and notify, skipping partials.
